Class VulkanModulePhysicalDevice

java.lang.Object
io.codetoil.curved_spacetime.vulkan.VulkanModulePhysicalDevice
public class VulkanModulePhysicalDevice extends Object
A Vulkan physical device — a GPU the driver has reported — together with everything queried about it.

Instances are created by createPhysicalDevice(VulkanModuleVulkanInstance, VulkanModuleEntrypoint, Logger), which enumerates every device, discards those that cannot present graphics or lack a required extension, and picks one. Discrete GPUs are preferred over integrated ones, and a device named in configuration wins outright.

The queried structures are allocated off-heap and are owned by this object, so every device that is enumerated must eventually be passed to cleanup() — including the ones that lose the selection.

  • Method Details

    • createPhysicalDevice

      public static VulkanModulePhysicalDevice createPhysicalDevice(VulkanModuleVulkanInstance instance, VulkanModuleEntrypoint vulkanModuleEntrypoint, Logger logger)
      Enumerates the available devices and selects one to render with.

      A device named by preferredDeviceName in configuration is taken if it is present and otherwise suitable; failing that, a discrete GPU is preferred over an integrated one. Every device not selected is cleaned up before returning.

      Parameters:
      instance - the instance to enumerate devices from
      vulkanModuleEntrypoint - the entrypoint supplying the preferred device name
      logger - the logger to write selection diagnostics to
      Returns:
      the selected physical device, owned by the caller
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if no device is present, or none meets the requirements

      Parameters:

      stack - the stack to allocate the result buffer on
      logger - the logger to write the device count to
      Returns:
      a buffer of VkPhysicalDevice handles, valid for the stack frame
      Throws:
      AssertionError - if enumeration fails
